data.name: Aishwarya
data.gender_notes: Aishwarya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aiśvarya, 'wealth, power', from īśvara, 'lord'. Its root is Sanskrit īśvara (ईश्वर). A classical Sanskrit term for prosperity. Aishwarya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Wealth; prosperity; power”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aishwarya expresses “Wealth; prosperity; power”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit aiśvarya, 'wealth, power', from īśvara, 'lord'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aishwarya total 42, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_english.name: Aishwarya
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aiśvarya, 'wealth, power', from īśvara, 'lord'. Its root is Sanskrit īśvara (ईश्वर). A classical Sanskrit term for prosperity. Aishwarya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Wealth; prosperity; power”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Aishwarya is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Wealth; prosperity; power”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Aishwarya is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Wealth; prosperity; power” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Aishwarya; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ऐश्वर्य, which is a compound of ऐश (God, Supreme Being) and वर्य (splendor, excellence, or power). It is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Vedas, the Puranas, and the Mahabharata.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for prosperity.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Aishwarya.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Aishwarya?
faq.a: A classical Sanskrit term for prosperity.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Aishwarya?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Aishwarya is 6 (ruling planet Venus). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Aishwarya?
faq.a: Friday is the traditional association for Aishwarya. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Aishwarya?
faq.a: Diamond is the traditional association for Aishwarya. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Aishwarya?
faq.a: White, Pink are the traditional associations for Aishwarya. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Aishwarya?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aishwarya total 42, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Aishwarya?
faq.a: The meaning of Aishwarya carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Aishwarya have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Aishwarya is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Wealth; prosperity; power”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Aishwarya?
faq.a: In English, Aishwarya is rendered as “Wealth; prosperity; power”.

faq.q: Is Aishwarya suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Aishwarya is used as a female given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.q: What is the full form of Aishwarya?
faq.a: Aishwarya is the full recorded form; any short forms are listed in the nicknames field.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name Aishwarya?
faq.a: Aishwarya is used in Sanskrit naming traditions.
